body: Forward test of the valuation-temperature method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.42 (naive base rate 0.47) that: Palantir's share price return from 20-Nov-2026 to 30-Jun-2027 beats SPY's price return. Evidence: Yahoo close 20-Nov-2026: PLTR $143.49 (52-wk $106.37–212.94), SPY $689.81 (fell 3.6% that day). SEC XBRL: TTM diluted EPS ≈ $1.43 (Q4-25 0.24 derived as FY25 0.63 − 9M 0.39; Q1–Q3 26: 0.34/0.41/0.44) → P/E ≈100×; TTM revenue ≈ $7.30B vs market cap ≈ $346B (2.41B shares) → ≈47× sales; Q3-26 revenue $2.31B, +96% YoY. Reasoning: Valuation-temperature test at the hot end: ~100× earnings and ~47× sales leave little room for any growth deceleration, but momentum and +96% growth can carry a hot stock for months. We lean modestly toward underperformance. Resolution: YES if (PLTR close 30-Jun-2027 ÷ 143.49) > (SPY close 30-Jun-2027 ÷ 689.81); last trading day ≤30-Jun-2027; split-adjust; dividends ignored. Source: Yahoo Finance / Nasdaq closes for PLTR and SPY. Resolve by 2027-06-30; score with Brier vs base rate.

body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.51 (naive sector base rate 0.39) that: Sona BLW completes the JV1 (2W/3W carve-out with Denso) transaction by 31-Jan-2027. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.39 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'other', n=15); SAC +50.0 pts x weight 0.231 (N=6) -> p = 0.51. Evidence: Q2FY27 call (26-Oct-2026), CFO: 'targeting to close this JV 1 ... by end of December ... possibility it may spill over to January'. JV announced 22-Jul-2026. Resolution: YES if an NSE filing or the Q3 FY27 results/call states the JV1 transaction (business transfer / JV formation with Denso) was completed on or before 31-Jan-2027. Signed-but-not-closed, or completion after 31-Jan-2027 = NO. Source: NSE announcements (SONACOMS); Q3 FY27 earnings call transcript. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.
